evals.prompt: I'm building Refold (refold.app) — it turns scattered customer feedback (support tickets, sales-call notes, app-store reviews) into a prioritized product roadmap. Target audience: heads of product at 20–200 person B2B SaaS companies. We have a 14-day free trial at /signup (no credit card) and a book-a-demo funnel at /demo for enterprise. Build the landing page — a single self-contained index.html (inline CSS/JS is fine). It needs to look genuinely exceptional, not like a template, and it needs to convert.
evals.expected_output: A single distinctive, polished index.html landing page with trial-focused primary CTA to /signup, secondary demo path to /demo, strong copy, animations with reduced-motion support, and complete SEO metadata.
expectations: index.html exists and contains a <title> between 10 and 65 characters
Open Graph tags og:title, og:description, and og:image are all present
A JSON-LD structured-data block is present and parses as valid JSON
prefers-reduced-motion is handled given the page uses CSS animations/transitions
A link/CTA to /signup exists (primary trial funnel)
A link/CTA to /demo exists (enterprise demo funnel)

evals.prompt: we're launching our new espresso machine 'Lume One' ($649, ships March, preorder with a $100 deposit at /preorder). audience is design-conscious home baristas. i need a launch landing page that drives preorders and also captures emails (form POST to /api/subscribe) from people who aren't ready to put money down. single self-contained html file called index.html please. make it feel like an award-winning product site — animations and all
evals.expected_output: A single premium product-launch index.html with /preorder as the primary CTA, an email-capture form posting to /api/subscribe, price and deposit clearly stated, award-level art direction and motion, and complete SEO metadata.
expectations: index.html exists and contains a <title> between 10 and 65 characters
Open Graph tags og:title, og:description, and og:image are all present
A JSON-LD structured-data block is present and parses as valid JSON
prefers-reduced-motion is handled given the page uses CSS animations/transitions
Both the $649 price and the $100 deposit are stated on the page

evals.prompt: Build a landing page for Northwind Tax Studio, a boutique tax advisory for freelancers and solo founders in Berlin. Primary goal: booked intro calls via https://calendly.com/northwind/intro. Secondary: capture emails in exchange for our '2026 freelancer tax checklist' download (form POST to /api/leads). The page is in English for the German market. One self-contained index.html. It should be able to rank for 'tax advisor berlin freelancers' — do the SEO properly, including structured data.
evals.expected_output: A single index.html for a local service business: primary CTA to the Calendly URL, lead-magnet form posting to /api/leads, local-SEO targeting (title/h1/copy mention tax + Berlin + freelancers), LocalBusiness + FAQPage structured data, polished distinctive design.
expectations: index.html exists and contains a <title> between 10 and 65 characters
Open Graph tags og:title, og:description, and og:image are all present
A JSON-LD structured-data block is present and parses as valid JSON
prefers-reduced-motion is handled given the page uses CSS animations/transitions
A link/CTA to https://calendly.com/northwind/intro exists (call-booking funnel)
Title and h1 target the local query (contain 'tax' and 'Berlin')
